briefing.headline: Soft landing holds as inflation eases and jobs stay resilient, though sentiment barely budges.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI eased to 2.6 percent for Sep 2026, creeping toward the Fed's target as price pressure fades.
Unemployment at 4.1 percent for Oct 2026gives households steady income to weather higher rates.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury lower, from 5.04 percent to 4.92 percent.
